# derivation source

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:derivationSource`](gmeow-derivationSource.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/derivationSource>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The ancestor lexical item or form from which the target is derived. Functional per relator: one source per [`EtymologicalDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-EtymologicalDerivation.md) (a derivation with multiple sources is modeled as multiple derivations).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) -> [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:derivationSource`](gmeow-derivationSource.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) to [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

```turtle
# --- The etymology: a typed derivation (borrowing) from Greek into English.
ex:etymology a gmeow:EtymologicalDerivation ;
    gmeow:derivationSource ex:greekOntos ;
    gmeow:derivationTarget ex:ontology ;
    gmeow:derivationKind   gmeow:derivationBorrowing .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use inside a [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) to name the single source work the product was derived from — at the honest tier (a sampled [`Recording`](../classes/gmeow-Recording.md), a covered [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md)).
- Use on an [`EtymologicalDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-EtymologicalDerivation.md) to name the single ancestor lexical item or form from which the target descends.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it outside a [`CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) relator and avoid more than one source — it is functional; a mashup of two sources gets two derivations or segment pins.
- Avoid naming multiple sources on one derivation (it is functional; a multi-source etymology is several derivations) and avoid swapping it with [`gmeow:derivationTarget`](gmeow-derivationTarget.md) — direction is ancestor to descendant.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:derivationSource`](gmeow-derivationSource.md) once from the relator to its ancestor (required by the someValuesFrom axiom); it specializes [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md), so the ancestor surfaces in generic observation queries.
- Point the [`CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) at one source [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md); pair with [`gmeow:derivationProduct`](gmeow-derivationProduct.md) and [`gmeow:derivationType`](gmeow-derivationType.md).
